purpose: Read-only primary toolchain API documentation for interpreting observed B scalar flags; no dependency implementation is inspected or modified.
paraphrase: Private scalar flags may mark cached conversions that lost precision. A floating value converted lossily to an integer can have private integer and floating caches while its public integer-validity flag remains unset. Classifying an integer from the private cache alone can therefore be wrong.
limits: The retained runtime probes establish the exact behavior of this installed Perl. The documentation does not itself establish LinkedSpec behavior or exhaustive compatibility.
